description: Portable specification of the six-total-epoch continuation launched on 2026-10-21; not a standalone CLI config.

training.data_split: Same fixed 40/10 synchronous-only episode split as the baseline
training.normalization: Exactly the parent's training-only state/action statistics and fixed ImageNet visual statistics
training.rng_limit: Fixed seed is reset; bitwise equivalence to an uninterrupted six-epoch run is not claimed

evaluation.note: Repeat the fixed baseline protocol for comparison; these seeds are disjoint from training but are not a new unseen evaluation set
